Report — GPUI-free logic split (read-only plan, base 4104d2bb2cee2a4504bc5193a594f3562a112ce0)

Note on trim diffs: no shell available, so `git diff --stat` could not be run. Post-trim reality below is inferred from worktree file listings + each worktree's `src/logic/mod.rs` / `src/platform/mod.rs` / `src/logic/diagram/` listing vs main tree. One inconsistency found (trim-chrome): `sharing.rs` deleted but `mod.rs` still declares it — crew mid-flight.

1. Post-trim survivor analysis (intersection over all 7 crews)

- trim-canvas (`trim-canvas/src/logic/mod.rs`, `diagram/`): deletes `import, library, relation, richtext, state, uml`; guts `logic/diagram/` to `mod.rs` only (7 files → 1). `mermaid.rs` stays but depends on `diagram` — at risk.
- trim-tables (`trim-tables/src/logic/mod.rs`): deletes `formula.rs`, `table.rs`. `logic/markdown/tables.rs` (md tables) stays.
- trim-obsidian (`trim-obsidian/src/logic/mod.rs`): deletes `embed.rs`.
- trim-chrome (`trim-chrome/src/logic/` listing): deletes `sharing.rs` (file gone, `mod.rs` not yet updated — broken intermediate).
- trim-sync (`trim-sync/src/platform/`, `mod.rs`): logic untouched; deletes `platform/git.rs`, `platform/update.rs`.
- trim-deps (`trim-deps/Cargo.toml`, `src/platform/`): logic untouched in worktree; `platform/pdf.rs` gone, but `Cargo.toml` still lists `pdf-writer/svg2pdf/resvg/latex-rust/mermaid-rs-renderer` — crew mid-flight, PDF + heavy deps go away.
- feat-footnotes (`feat-footnotes/src/logic/`, `markdown/` listings identical to base; `footnote` absent from base `markdown/mod.rs`): logic unchanged; footnotes land in `views/editor` + shell. No logic-crate impact, re-verify at merge time.

Survives ALL trims (safe to move now): `block, commands, daily, history, layout, markdown/{mod,dates,front,lists,search,tables}, merge, note, prefs, rank, recall, wiki` (+ `lang.rs` support). Contested — leave in app until its crew lands: `table, formula` (tables), `embed` (obsidian), `sharing` (chrome), `diagram/*-full, mermaid, import, library, relation, richtext, state, uml` (canvas), `ui/print.rs` pure-SVG (deps trim kills it anyway; it imports `ui::{figure,svg,theme}` + `diagram`, so never logic-crate material).

2. Crate boundary table (recommended: 1 logic crate now, platform crate optional second)

| Crate | Members (post-trim safe set) | gpui-freedom evidence (file:line) |
|---|---|---|
| `inkuno-logic` (new, path `crates/logic/`) | `lang.rs` (moved from `src/lang.rs`), `logic/markdown/{mod,dates,front,lists,search,tables}.rs`, `logic/block.rs`, `logic/wiki.rs`, `logic/note.rs`, `logic/merge.rs`, `logic/layout.rs`, `logic/history.rs`, `logic/prefs.rs`, `logic/daily.rs`, `logic/commands.rs`, `logic/rank.rs`, `logic/recall.rs` | `src/lang.rs:1-12` std-only + CodeSearch `gpui` in `src/lang.rs` = no hits; `logic/markdown/mod.rs:11-14` only `std::ops::Range`, `unicode-segmentation`, `unicode-width`; `logic/table.rs:1-6` doc "no dependency on GPUI" (stays in app for now, same pattern); `logic/prefs.rs:1-28` std-only struct; `logic/history.rs:5,9-14` only `std::path`; `logic/merge.rs:6` only `std::ops::Range`; `logic/embed.rs:5-7` only `std::ops::Range` + `super::markdown`; layer test `src/shell/tests/mod.rs:52-80` enforces `src/logic` never contains `gpui / crate::platform / crate::ui / crate::views / crate::shell` |
| deferred, stay in app | `logic/table.rs`, `logic/formula.rs`, `logic/sharing.rs`, `logic/embed.rs`, `logic/diagram/*`, `logic/mermaid.rs`, `logic/import.rs`, `logic/library.rs`, `logic/relation.rs`, `logic/richtext.rs`, `logic/state.rs`, `logic/uml.rs` | move/delete only after owning trim crew merges (each still gpui-free today, but their fate is deletion, not extraction) |
| `inkuno-platform` (optional step 6, not required for goal) | `platform/{clock,export,link,vault}.rs` (+ `git.rs`/`update.rs` iff sync-trim fails; never `pdf.rs`) | `src/platform/mod.rs:1` "No gpui here" + CodeSearch `gpui` in `src/platform/**` = no hits (only doc comments) |
| stays in `inkuno` app crate | `src/actions.rs` (gpui: `actions.rs:4` `use gpui::actions`), `src/shell/**` incl `tests/` (harness `tests/mod.rs:36` `use gpui::{Hsla, TestAppContext}`), `src/views/**`, `src/ui/**` (`ui/print.rs:12-17` imports `ui::{figure,svg,theme}` — gpui-adjacent), e2e `shell/tests/end_to_end/` (22 chapters, `end_to_end/mod.rs:20-60` `Journey` on `Entity<Shell>` + `gpui::VisualTestContext`), `tests/mcp.rs` (process-spawn integration test, stays at root) | — |

Dependency arrows (must hold; matches `ARCHITECTURE.md` layer rule + observed `use crate::`):
`inkuno` app → `inkuno-logic`; `inkuno-logic` → {`unicode-segmentation`, `unicode-width`, `regex`} only (+ `serde_json` later iff `import.rs` ever moves — don't). Internal: `block→markdown` (`block.rs:9`), `wiki→markdown+note` (`wiki.rs:5-6`), `note→markdown` (`note.rs:5`), `recall→markdown+note+lang` (`recall.rs:7-9`), `sharing→markdown` (`sharing.rs:5`), `table→markdown+lang` (`table.rs:8,1239`), `formula→markdown+lang` (`formula.rs:8,579`), `state→richtext` (`state.rs:7`), `relation→diagram`, `library→diagram+relation`, `mermaid→diagram`, `import→diagram+lang` — the last group is why the diagram cluster must move atomically or not at all. `lang` has no intra-repo deps (only std). No `macro_rules!` in `src/logic/**` (verified) — no macro-sharing problem. `mcp/` uses `logic, platform, pure ui` (`ARCHITECTURE.md`, `main.rs:130-133` early `mcp::run()` before window) — after split, `mcp` in app crate depends on `inkuno-logic` the same way.

`Cargo.toml` shape: workspace root `[workspace] members = [".", "crates/logic"]` (later `crates/platform`), single shared `Cargo.lock`. `crates/logic/Cargo.toml`: `regex 1.12.2, unicode-segmentation 1.13.3, unicode-width 0.2.2` (pin to the versions already in lockfile — do NOT let cargo re-resolve gpui's 710-dep graph; per `ARCHITECTURE.md` lockfile fragility rule). App crate: `inkuno-logic = { path = "crates/logic", version = "0.0.1" }`, keep `gpui 0.2.2`, remove nothing else in this step. e2e/shell tests stay in app crate and reach logic via re-export shim (`pub use inkuno_logic::*` or `crate::logic` modules becoming `pub use` wrappers) so no test-file edits.

3. Migration steps (each stays green; writer order)

0. Precondition: land or explicitly defer-position the 7 trims. Recommended: implement split against the intersection set above so it is correct whichever trims land; contested files untouched.
1. Add `[workspace]` + `crates/logic/` with the safe-set files moved verbatim (preserve `#[cfg(test)]` unit tests in place) + moved `lang.rs` as `inkuno_logic::lang`. App `src/lang.rs` becomes `pub use inkuno_logic::lang::*;` shim. `src/logic/mod.rs` becomes per-module `pub use inkuno_logic::...;` shims. No logic edits.
2. Fix `use crate::lang::` / `use crate::logic::` paths inside moved files to `crate::lang` / `crate::markdown` within new crate (mechanical). Keep `tr()` semantics identical.
3. Update `layers_only_depend_downwards` (`shell/tests/mod.rs:46-80`): add `crates/logic` to the scan with the same forbidden list; keep `src/logic` shim rule until shims removed.
4. `cargo test -p inkuno-logic` (no gpui, no `xcrun metal` chain) must pass; then `cargo check` workspace; then full app suite still passes via shims. Only then remove shims and change app call sites to `inkuno_logic::` (pure rename, one module per commit).
5. Move `tests/mcp.rs`-adjacent pure helpers if any; leave the test itself at root (it drives `CARGO_BIN_EXE_inkuno`).
6. (Optional, after logic green) repeat for `inkuno-platform`; needs its own audit of `vault.rs` deps (`flate2? notify? serde_json?`) — not covered by this plan, flag as follow-up.

Test-time estimate (no run possible read-only; reasoning): logic crate builds ~10 crates, zero gpui build-scripts, zero metal shaders. Expected `cargo test -p inkuno-logic` cold ~10–30 s, warm ~2–5 s, vs today's every-`cargo check/test` pays the gpui 0.2.2 metal chain (~710 locked deps, hard-fails without `xcrun metal`). Unit tests for markdown/tables/wiki/lists move into the fast crate; the 30 shell modules + 22 e2e chapters stay in the slow app crate unchanged.

4. Risks / open questions

- R1 (biggest) `lang::tr` French-in-test coupling: `lang.rs:13-24` defaults to French under `cfg!(test)`, with `#[cfg(test)] in_english` thread-local (`lang.rs:24-45`). `cfg(test)` is per-crate: once `lang` lives in `inkuno-logic`, the app's `shell/tests` (compiled with `cfg(test)` in the app crate) will build `inkuno-logic` WITHOUT `cfg(test)`, so tests silently flip to English and dozens of assertions break. Mitigate: replace `cfg!(test)` default with explicit init (e.g. `INKUNO_TEST_LANG=fr` set by test harness `CONFIG` guard in `shell/tests/mod.rs:38`, or `lang::set_french(true)` called from a `#[ctor]`/setup in app tests + logic tests). Must be solved in step 1, else everything looks green-but-wrong.
- R2 trim-chrome breakage: worktree deletes `sharing.rs` but `mod.rs` still declares it. Writer must check at implementation time whether chrome-trim landed; if yes, `sharing.rs` is deleted, not moved (shell `sharing.rs`/clipboard/export-copy call sites go with it). Same pattern for obsidian (`embed.rs`) and tables (`table.rs`/`formula.rs` + `views/sheet`, `shell/tables.rs`, e2e `csv/md_tables/table_*` chapters).
- R3 canvas/mermaid entanglement: `mermaid.rs:762-775` and `formula.rs:579` reach into `diagram`/`markdown`; `state.rs→richtext`, `library→diagram+relation`. Never split the diagram cluster across crates — move all-or-nothing (currently: nothing, per canvas trim).
- R4 `commands.rs:9-22` `Group::{Table,Diagram}` variants become dead after trims but are referenced by palette/shell; keep them in the logic crate (harmless) rather than pruning, to stay green.
- R5 `ui/print.rs` looks "pure" but imports `ui::{figure,svg,theme}` + `base64/ttf-parser` + `diagram` — NOT logic-crate eligible; dies with the deps trim.
- R6 lockfile: adding a workspace member must not re-resolve; pin exact locked versions of `regex/unicode-*`, run with `--locked`/`--offline` first.
- Open: exact `platform/vault.rs` deps for a future platform crate (not read); exact footnote touch points in `views/editor` (logic unaffected per listings, confirm at merge); whether `import.rs` (`serde_json`, `import.rs:7`) belongs to canvas trim or survives — left in app for now.
